development.source: current web datasets; no original-source restoration

selection.subgroup_limit_combination: max(1pp, 5% of baseline); all smaller groups still reported

reconciliation.infeasible: explicit conflict and baseline fallback; no relaxed bounds, deleted meals or changed totals

phase2_entry: at least one phase1 model passes all preregistered gates; otherwise do not change menus
phase2_evaluation: same primary order and risk gates plus common-hit errors, hit rate, revenue coverage, repeat <=80%, menu count guarantees

stop.rule: stop only after at least three distinct structural directions and reasonable combinations/ablations provide no additional stable improvement meeting these gates

test_policy: optional once-only existing-interval retest after freeze, never used for selection or stopping
deployment: independent optional module; never overwrite web default
